## WORK

Complete the first ordered proof attempts from OPEN_TARGETS while keeping all existing programme files intact. Stage **AUDIT**.

- **A1 — PROVED:** exact corner formula for every n≥1 and all four corners, including removable singularities. The proof reconstructs cardinal normalization and sums the Fourier rhombus. Primary CDMV 2008 §2 eqs. (1),(3),(6a–c) and Bos et al. 2006 Theorem 2 were checked as LITERATURE; their proofs are not inherited. Exact SymPy checks n=1…6 cover 332 corner-cardinal equalities.
- **B5 — PROVED in every degree n≥2:** distinct x coordinates make the constant vector cyclic for H_x; the H_y pattern permits only three entries in the first column. This gives span{I,H_x,H_y}, and the collision discriminant supplies a proper algebraic exceptional set. Exact rational LDL witnesses n=2…6 pass; full-map ranks are deduced through the written reduction, not mislabeled direct computations. The Padua counterexample remains valid.
- **A5-partial — local replacement certificates PROVED:** every degenerate_max call in two separate n=3…8 executions is logged: two at n=3, none at n=4…8. Exact representatives (0,acos(±1/√3)) have vanishing cardinal value/gradient, exact background critical points, rational angle enclosures of width 1e-18 and rigorous Hessian margin >3.5 on radius-.0021 angle l1 discs covering the original .002 neighborhoods. The literal floating iterates are not exact roots. Trace coverage is MEASURED; the six maxima counts remain MEASURED and the other four counting obligations remain OPEN.

A short optional B1 note records a failed adjoint-closure route and leaves the target OPEN. No new PD-N or historical novelty claim.
